comment: No source is published. The cutoff knob is configured 1.30103 to 4 and process() raises ten to that number, so the knob spans 20Hz to 10000Hz and the FREQ jack moves it by a decade per volt rather than an octave. The result is then clamped between 20Hz and 0.45 of the sample rate, so at low sample rates the top of the knob's travel is cut off. Drive crossfades each output against a hyperbolic tangent of twice its value and is not clamped, so a drive CV past 1V extrapolates beyond the saturated copy. The panel prints FREQ, RES and DRIVE both on the knobs and on the three CV jacks.
